rrls.configuration.interpolateProgress.t:
In vanilla minecraft interpolation starts at ~75%, turn it on if you want to do progress based interpolation.
This can lead to early fading, but is necessary for some easings.
rrls.configuration.interpolateAtEnd.tool: Start interpolation only when the progress bar is completely filled.
